definitions.explanation: The physical item in question, as opposed to a description, photo, or catalog listing. Often used when asking to see or inspect the real thing.

definitions.gloss: stock on hand; current inventory; display item
definitions.explanation: The last remaining item in stock, often a display model or floor sample sold at a discount.

notes:
USAGE:
{現品|げんぴん} is used in retail, business, and online shopping contexts. Sense 1 emphasizes seeing or verifying the real thing, while sense 2 refers specifically to floor samples or last-in-stock items sold at a discount.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現品|げんぴん}⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧ (actual item inspection)
- {現品|げんぴん}⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧ (limited to current stock / floor model only)
- {現品|げんぴん}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧ (clearance of display items)
- {現品|げんぴん}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (inventory control)
